text: これで　かなり　つかまえやすく　なったぞ！

structure.jp: かなり　つかまえやすく　なったぞ！
structure.en: it's become a lot easier to catch!

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means 'easy to do'. つかまえやすく = 'easy to catch' (in the form that goes before なる).

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.span: つかまえやすく　なった
patterns.explanation: Changing a final い to く and adding なる says something becomes that way. つかまえやすく なった = 'became easier to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. なったぞ = 'it has become so, see!'
